_comment: Mongolian voice for the manga translator. Add rules and example pairs here; every translation and polish call reads this file. 'ai' = how a literal translation sounds (avoid), 'natural' = how it should read.
rules: Write the way Mongolian webtoon readers actually talk: short, punchy, spoken Mongolian, not written/literary style.
Cut every word the scene already makes clear: pronouns (би, чи, тэр), place words (тэндээ, энд), and filler like 'just', 'finally', 'even', 'properly' unless they carry the point.
Prefer spoken forms and particles: гархад, боллоо, шүү дээ, л, бүр, юм чинь.
Keep rudeness and swearing at the same strength as the English (shit → баас, not хог).
Numbers may stay as digits when that is how people write them (4р давхар).
A short exclamation stays short: 'Hold it right there!' → 'Зогс!'.
Never pad a line to explain it; if the Mongolian is shorter than the English, that is usually right.

examples.en: I JUST... NEED TO GET TO THE FOURTH FLOOR, AND THEN I'LL FINALLY BE THERE...
examples.ai: Би дөрөв давхар луу л гараад л... тэгвэл арай гэж нэг юм хүрэх нь...

examples.en: YOU DIDN'T EVEN LOOK AT IT PROPERLY!
examples.ai: Чи зүгээр сайн харж ч үзээгүй атлаа!
examples.natural: Чи бүр сайн хараагүй шүү дээ!

examples.en: YOU CAN JUST TELL WHAT SHIT IS.
examples.ai: Хог ямар байдгийг шууд харсан ч мэднэ.
examples.natural: Баас ямар байдгийг хараад л мэднэ.
